_note: Descriptions anglaises de Dot Page, une par module. Le README (français) reste la source : mettre à jour ce fichier quand une description y change.
dot-hub: The one iCUE widget: it shows every Dot module, served by Dot Companion on your PC, which also keeps their settings.
dot-system-monitor: FPS of the running game and 4 live hardware sensors (CPU, GPU), with a history you can browse by touch.
dot-audio: Master volume, mute every mic with one tap, per-app mixer, equalizer, audio device switching and now playing.
dot-calendar: Dot-matrix clock, month, week and agenda views, and a countdown to the next event with a JOIN button for Meet, Zoom and Teams. Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars through private ICS links, offline public holidays. Light and dark themes, any accent color, all 8 Edge sizes.
dot-steam: Steam games: up to 8 dot-matrix games launched by touch (hold, tap or double tap), last played game in the spotlight, downloads in progress and friends in game.
dot-clock: Big dot-matrix clock: hours and minutes in large dots, seconds and colon in the accent color, 12 h or 24 h, bold or thin dot font. Free date format, any time zone (city, abbreviation or offset), custom footer text, adjustable colors. One layout per size.
dot-bambulab: Bambu Lab 3D printer monitor: progress, temperatures, AMS, pause and stop.
dot-discord: Discord voice channel: who is there and who is talking, mic, sound, volumes and hang up.
dot-homeassistant: Control your home through Home Assistant: lights, plugs, blinds, thermostat, lock, sensors and scenes, sorted by room.
dot-weather: Current weather, hour-by-hour curve and 5-day forecast, with pictograms and the temperature in dots (Open-Meteo).
dot-fans: Live speed of every fan and the pump, with average and history.
dot-apps: Windows app launcher: dot-matrix icons, one tap to open, groups in tabs and running apps flagged.
dot-battery: Battery level of wireless devices: Logitech headset, CORSAIR devices and Bluetooth devices. Percentage, charging state and low battery alert.
dot-network: Continuous ping to chosen servers with latency and packet loss history, live upload and download speed, and a speed test started with a tap.
dot-gmail: Gmail unread mail by category and latest messages (sender, subject), with open, mark as read and archive, on one or more accounts.
dot-slack: Slack mentions and direct messages, unread channels and latest messages, status and notification pause with one tap.
dot-homelab: Dashboard for self-hosted services: downloads in progress and upcoming releases from Radarr and Sonarr, pending Seerr requests, online/offline state of other apps.
dot-notes: Checklists and free notes typed right on the screen, one tab per list, kept from one session to the next.
dot-plex: What's playing on your Plex server (who watches what, progress, quality), recently added and On Deck.
dot-ia: Claude usage limits of two accounts side by side: 5-hour session and weekly limit, with reset time.
dot-home: Page 1 home: one tile per Dot widget, a tap takes you to the right iCUE page.
dot-github: Contribution graph in dots, current streak, pull requests, notifications and GitHub Actions runs.
dot-calculator: Calculator and converter: units, currencies, bases and time zones, result in large dots.
